item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Powerball jackpot grows to $663 million
item.description: There was no Powerball jackpot winner in Monday night's drawing, according to the lottery's website.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for July 28
item.description: Pasco man set to become oldest executed in Florida in double execution. Plus, questions remain after FHP pursuit ends in crash, teen passenger dies.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two St. Pete men charged with attempted murder after victim shot in chest
item.description: Two St. Petersburg men were arrested by police after a victim was in the chest during a robbery last month, authorities said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Second octogenarian in modern US history faces lethal injection as Florida set to execute 2 in a day
item.description: Florida is set to become the first state in nearly a decade to carry out two executions in a single day, planning lethal injections Tuesday for an ex-police officer and an octogenarian.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Landing a job now takes more than just clicking apply, career experts say
item.description: Hiring has slowed and AI is changing recruiting. Experts say landing a job now takes strategy, not just mass applying.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: Solar loan risks
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 Reporter Susan El Khoury advises homeowners to carefully review loan terms, projected savings, fees, and repayment obligations before signing a solar financing agreement.
